issues.title: DEFAULT GRIP CONVENTION DEFECT: frame alignment (blade along fist-up) embeds 1.49 studs of a straight blade INSIDE the hanging R15 arm
issues.symptom: grip_sane on a frame-aligned DemoSword at NEUTRAL pose: grip_offset 0 studs / blade_up 0 deg but blade_in_arm_studs=1.49 (max 1.0) - the fist-up axis parallels the forearm bone on a hanging arm, so the resting blade rides inside the limb (the user-screenshot defect, now measured)
issues.repro: stamp_frame + make_tool + grip_tool(no args) any straight >3-stud blade onto workspace.AgentRig; oracle_check grip_sane -> FAIL 1.49 studs embedded at 0 deg
issues.resolution: PENDING - weapon-joint sub-project decides the rest-orientation convention (classic Roblox tools cant the blade FORWARD out of the fist via the RightGripAttachment C0 rotation; a 15-25 deg forward cant clears the arm while staying under grip_sane 35-deg bound). Interim: builders clear it with grip_tool rot args guided by the blade_in_arm_studs number.

issues.title: MECHANIC commit hygiene: sweeps untracked/dirty files into its commit + double [mechanic] prefix
issues.symptom: mechanic commit 4f3c5f4a included sidecar/_repro_verify.py, all staging entries, and learnings files alongside its actual fix (src/Tools/Mesh.luau); subject reads [mechanic] [mechanic]
issues.repro: let a forever-cycle MECHANIC stage commit while the tree has untracked files; inspect git show --stat of the [mechanic] commit

issues.title: add_keyframe wedged by a stuck ChangeHistory recording (stale recording open across the whole session)
issues.symptom: factory BUILD (weapon-sword, 2026-07-10) reported add_keyframe unusable - worked around via manual KeyframeSequence build; every bridge luau call warns [no undo recording: a stale recording is stuck open; changes applied unrecorded]
issues.repro: leave a ChangeHistoryService recording open (e.g. a tool interrupted mid-recording), then call add_keyframe - it wedges; bridge luau shows the stale-recording warning on every call

issues.title: ORACLE BUG: grip_sane blind to blade-vs-arm penetration (human-caught suite-vs-eyes disagreement)
issues.symptom: grip_sane PASS 0 studs / 0 deg while the capture (user screenshot, 2026-07-10) shows the blade embedded in the forearm at the hold pose - blade-role vs arm-part clearance is asserted nowhere and was not even a DECLARED blindspot
issues.repro: stamp_frame + make_tool + grip_tool(no args) a sword onto workspace.AgentRig with the elbow bent, run oracle_check grip_sane: PASS despite the blade visibly inside RightLowerArm
issues.resolution: SP2b demo follow-up: grip_sane gains blade_arm_penetration_studs magnitude (blade-role parts vs RightUpperArm/RightLowerArm oriented AABBs at the computed grip pose) with a FAIL bound - sword-in-arm becomes a number, not an eyeball call

issues.title: ORACLE CATCH #1: joint_census flagged spawn_rig's fixture as a MIXED rig (15 Motor6D + 15 AnimationConstraint)
issues.symptom: oracle_check joint_census on workspace.AgentRig -> FAIL 'MIXED rig: 15 Motor6D + 15 AnimationConstraint (animations will half-play)' - the Avatar Joint Upgrade ships AnimationConstraints that NativeRig.buildJoints never stripped
issues.repro: spawn_rig, then oracle_check {check:'joint_census', args:{rig:'game.Workspace.AgentRig'}} on a pre-fix build
issues.resolution: FIXED in SP2b T5: NativeRig.finish strips AnimationConstraints+BallSocketConstraints after buildJoints (the PlayBridge.convertToMotor6D pattern). joint_census stays STRICT - no constraints-inert nuance; a mixed rig is the T-pose trap class and must FAIL.

issues.title: Build stage completed without emitting FACTORY_BUILD_JSON and harness captured no partial output
issues.symptom: "status": "BLOCKED", "reason": "build produced no FACTORY_BUILD_JSON" with buildSteps/buildNotes/verifyEvidence/verifyReasons all null
issues.repro: Run the weapon-sword rung's build stage in edit mode and inspect the cycle record: the build agent's final message lacks the FACTORY_BUILD_JSON line and the harness stores nulls instead of any transcript/partial notes, leaving retro blind to the failure cause.

issues.title: Lighting.Technology not settable at PluginSecurity
issues.symptom: Technology property was locked (PluginSecurity) - left at place default
issues.repro: In edit mode, call set_property on game.Lighting Technology (e.g. Future) and observe the write is refused due to plugin security level

issues.title: Vision sidecar capture failure during BUILD stage
issues.symptom: capture pipeline down (CaptureService no screenshot after repeated retries) - verified geometrically instead
issues.repro: In edit mode, call capture repeatedly during a long build session; CaptureService returns no screenshot on every retry, forcing the visual pass to be deferred.

issues.title: Capture/filmstrip sidecar returns frozen foreign frames instead of the Studio viewport
issues.symptom: all captures byte-identical dark frames with stray CLICK ME GUI despite raycast confirming camera aimed at rig; filmstrip oracle unrenderable from any angle both rounds
issues.repro: In edit mode with the vision sidecar running, call capture (or capture_animation on any rig) twice and byte-compare the returned images; they come back identical dark frames not showing the rig, reproducing whenever the sidecar is bound to a stale/foreign window (e.g. a user play session).

issues.title: Capture pipeline returns byte-blank frames for entire session (frozen/foreign viewport + opaque PlaceAnnotations CoreGui overlay)
issues.symptom: capture, capture_angles(5), and a scriptable-camera shot of a 50-stud magenta neon test part aimed dead-center all returned byte-identical black frames; 'Viewport unrenderable: capture, capture_angles(5), and scriptable-camera test-part shot all byte-blank'
issues.repro: In EDIT mode with the vision sidecar running while a PlaceAnnotations CoreGui overlay is present (or the Studio viewport is foreign/frozen), spawn a large Neon part, aim the camera at it, and call capture twice - frames come back black and byte-identical instead of showing the part.

issues.title: playtest_eval blocked when LoadStringEnabled is off
issues.symptom: playtest_eval unavailable (LoadStringEnabled off) but visual+interaction evidence covered the oracle
issues.repro: With ServerScriptService.LoadStringEnabled=false, playtest_start then call playtest_eval with any code — it cannot execute, forcing verification to fall back to captures/logs.

issues.title: CaptureService produced no screenshots all session
issues.symptom: CaptureService produced no screenshots all session (headless/unfocused Studio), so visual checks were replaced by numeric verification
issues.repro: Run a build cycle with Studio unfocused/headless and call capture or grip_tool - no image is returned for the entire session

issues.title: Verify stage returned no verdict
issues.symptom: status UNVERIFIED with verifyEvidence null and verifyReasons ['verify produced no verdict']
issues.repro: Complete a build rung in a session where capture is unavailable; the verify stage terminates without emitting any pass/fail verdict or evidence

issues.title: Verify stage emits no verdict
issues.symptom: "status":"UNVERIFIED","reason":null with "verifyEvidence":null and "verifyReasons":["verify produced no verdict"]
issues.repro: Run the factory verify stage on a completed weapon-sword rung in EDIT mode and observe it returns no verdict/evidence (verifyEvidence stays null) instead of a pass/fail.

issues.title: save_mesh restore-stash exceeds 200k-char engine limit and consumes the mesh handle
issues.symptom: save_mesh failed (tool's restore-stash exceeds a 200k-char engine limit; EditableMesh handle already consumed so manual re-persist impossible) — Handle.MeshId is empty and it has zero mesh children
issues.repro: In EDIT mode, generate_mesh a detailed Cube model (e.g. 'naval cutlass' at 4 studs) then call save_mesh on it; the stash serialization exceeds the 200k-char limit, errors, and leaves the MeshPart with an empty MeshId.

issues.title: save_mesh error leaves a ChangeHistory recording wedged open, blocking add_keyframe
issues.symptom: add_keyframe was blocked by a wedged ChangeHistory recording left open by save_mesh's error, so the clip had to be built via run_luau instead
issues.repro: In EDIT mode, trigger a save_mesh failure (see above), then call add_keyframe on any rig — it fails because the prior recording was never closed.

issues.title: ORACLE BUG: scale_ratio - suite vs capture disagree (weapon-sword)
issues.symptom: suite said: PASS longest_studs=3.600 (real blade geometry) | capture showed: Play renders a featureless bar, not a sculpted blade — mesh not persisted (MeshId empty); suite has no MeshId-non-empty/persistence check so it green-lit a non-persisted mesh
issues.repro: oracle_suite on game.StarterPack.Sword vs a full capture review (audit run, rung weapon-sword)

issues.title: ORACLE BUG: grip_sane - suite vs capture disagree (weapon-sword)
issues.symptom: suite said: PASS blade_up_angle_deg=0 grip_offset_studs=0 on edit-session mesh | capture showed: in-Play the held item is a plain bar; grip geometry judged against a mesh that does not exist at runtime
issues.repro: oracle_suite on game.StarterPack.Sword vs a full capture review (audit run, rung weapon-sword)

issues.title: save_mesh local-serialize path leaves Handle.MeshId empty
issues.symptom: Handle MeshPart MeshId="" in edit — session-only EditableMesh never truly persisted; equipped tool renders as only a floating red marker with zero blade geometry in play
issues.repro: generate_mesh a prop, save_mesh it, then get_properties on the resulting MeshPart and observe MeshId is empty rather than an rbxassetid; equip in a playtest to see it render invisible

issues.title: Build produced no FACTORY_BUILD_JSON before iteration cap
issues.symptom: build produced no FACTORY_BUILD_JSON; iteration cap reached — the work so far is applied; run again to continue
issues.repro: Run the weapon-sword rung; the grip-fitting loop consumes all iterations re-tilting the weld against a canonical grip_sane magnitude that never changes, so the cycle hits the iteration cap without ever emitting FACTORY_BUILD_JSON.
